newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA-BUDGET SURPLUS AT 30 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA-BUDGET SURPLUS AT 30 MLN LATS.

text.p: Latvia is currently running a budget surplus of 30 million lats, made up of revenues of 320.09 million lats and expenditure of 290.01 million lats.

The ministry said in a statement that total state debt came to 415.23 million lats and was financed by 135.47 million lats of T-bills and bonds and IMF and World Bank loans worth 61.28 million lats and 63.27 million lats respectively.
Latvia is planning a deficite-free budget this year after a 40 million funding shortage in 1996.
